rows.label: The Deadlock Protocol
rows.note: requires Saturn Junction and Vox Solaris

conditions: The quest gives the main blueprint; only the three component blueprints are farmed in the Granum Void.
bonuses: Keep the Xoris: it is the only weapon that can free Solaris captives in the Void.

groups.activity: Treasurer crown, then Golden Hand Tribute
conditions: A Treasurer drops one crown after roughly 2-5 minutes; spending it opens a 60-second Void attempt. All Golden Hand Tributes close when that attempt ends.
Only Rank 3 drops Protea parts: reach 75 kills solo. Each additional squad member raises every rank threshold by 25.
Do not free Solaris captives on the Corpus Ship before entering; a live bug can disable abilities inside the Void and afterward.
The crown tier comes from the mission level where the Treasurer spawned, not from the Golden Hand you use.
bonuses: Run solo and hold one position; movement spreads spawns out and makes the 75-kill target slower.
A charged Xoris throw frees each of three Void captives for +20 seconds; yellow particles add +5 seconds.
Preparation restores starting energy after the Void load-in. Mesa or Revenant can clear from high ground; an On-Call crew or Vapor Specter can substitute.
Farm the Systems tier last or fold Zenith crowns into Sisters of Parvos or Steel Path play to soften its long RNG tail.

disclosures.title: the one rule that saves crowns
disclosures.body: Rank 1 and 2 never drop Protea components. Every failed Rank 3 attempt consumes its crown and ends the mission's only Void chance, so bring the Xoris and a reliable clearing setup before spending one.

conditions: Start the three components in parallel; a free Warframe slot is required to claim Protea.
